posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md:
I thought a good discussion could be debated here, (an inspiration from Justin’s post about inner tube isolators), im currently using Barry "Stabl-levl" vibration/level isolators, they inflate the same as a standard tire valve. i have plenty of near by road vibrations, so with a interferometer set i can see how well they work , ive yet to need to re-inflate, another benefit is if they goes flat, it has a built in chock to hold the table up until its replaced. i purchased two sets of 4 (just in case i get a flat!) 

i got them quite cheaply from E-bay ......

[http://www.aektechnology.com/bcdi/machi ... Series.pdf](http://www.aektechnology.com/bcdi/machinery/pdf/SLM%20Series.pdf)

they are rated for a few hundred pounds each so they are easly over kill for my holotable. has any one else used these?

posts.content_md: These are interesting. Let me know how they work. They are designed for the opposite problem of a table (high impact impulses).
